translations.text: Intellect is in the face, beyond every other part, and memory is in the brain; desire is in the [?] of the liver (a fair custom), and anger is always in the gall.
Then fear is in the heart, and breath is in the lungs; joy is in the [?] in every part, and thought is in the kidney.
Blood is in bodies (a fair custom); the soul is always in the blood; the spirit is in the soul without evil; the mind is in the heart, without fault [?].
Faith is in the heart without taboo, and Christ is in every faith; tidings [?] are in wisdom from every quarter, and the spirit is in the intellect. I. [?]
